purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: January 26–February 1, 2025 Authority-to-Operations Window
question: Which material federal authority objects signed or initiated from January 26 through February 1, 2025 had acquired a verifiable administrative or operating form by July 29, 2026, and what state had each reached by September 25, 2026?
bluf: Four January 2025 commands acquired inspectable administrative carriers by July 29, 2026: military-readiness direction became a governed personnel process; the Guantánamo migrant-operations memorandum became a named interagency operation; educational-freedom direction became several bounded guidance lanes; and deregulation policy became OMB counting rules plus an operating FAR-rewrite system. Their common factual grammar is command to carrier to workflow to review or formalization—not one coordinated program or proof of policy success.
evidence_cutoff_note: The action-date window is January 26–February 1, 2025. Four objects were selected independently for materiality, lifecycle traceability and primary-source receipts. Signature, publication, guidance, implementation, operation, litigation, deviation, proposed rulemaking and observed outcome remain separate clocks; the set is not exhaustive.
use_note: Use as the factual lifecycle lane for the January 26–February 1, 2025 action-date window. Do not collapse command into operation, guidance into delivery, transfer into final disposition, a class deviation into a final government-wide FAR rule, or the four objects into one coordinated program.
entities: United States Department of Homeland Security

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
